🌟 ideon | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a unified, visual, and collaborative workspace for managing projects, code repositories, notes, and tasks, replacing scattered tools and abstract folder structures.
✨ Key Features: • Spatial Canvas for organization • Live Integrations with Git platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Forgejo) • Support for Markdown notes, images, links, and files • Real-time multiplayer collaboration
📖 Summary: Ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace that allows users to organize projects, notes, and tasks on an infinite canvas. It replaces traditional folder structures with spatial organization, enabling real-time collaboration and historical tracking of workspace evolution.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 domainsearcher-app | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: Helping entrepreneurs and startups find and objectively choose the most suitable domain name for their new venture.
✨ Key Features: • AI-powered domain name generation • Real-time domain availability checking • Multi-dimensional scoring (LEN, PRO, MEM, BRD, ZON, FIT) • Adjustable scoring weights
📖 Summary: DomainSearcher is a free, browser-based tool that helps users find and select the best domain name for their startup. It uses AI to generate domain name candidates based on a startup idea, checks their real-time availability across various TLDs, and scores them on multiple criteria like length, pronounceability, memorability, brandability, and fit with the app idea.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🚀 logocreator | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Quickly generating professional logos and brand assets using AI, with an emphasis on ease of use and accessibility.
✨ Key Features: • AI-powered logo generation • Brand kit export • Free and account-less operation • Optional authentication and rate limiting • Support for AI model edits (Flux.1 Kontext)
📖 Summary: LogoCreator is an open-source, AI-powered logo generator that allows users to design and export brand-ready logos and full brand kits in seconds. It operates on a free, account-less model, leveraging advanced AI models for generation and editing.
